messages:
Teresa L: Short brief: create a benchmark narrative tying latency to unit economics for launch. Need 3 chart concepts, one-sentence headline for each, and a routing matrix (self-serve vs sales). Keep messaging testable.
Matt G: I'll assemble simple, engineer-friendly chart mocks: 1) ms/token vs sequence length bins with $/1M overlay, 2) workload comparison (chat / batch / embed), 3) cumulative savings after optimizations.
Elaine: Add accessibility notes and sample query labels per bin. Also include a tiny footnote listing model variant and hardware baseline.
Srini: Propose two landing variants: Numeric (engineer) and Outcome (business). Metric: conversions and sales-qualified leads. Routing rule: if trial >120k tokens/day OR sustained p95 >350ms => tag for sales.
Josh: CTAs: "Explore Hosted" for self-serve, "Request Performance Eval" for sales. Webinar idea: interactive slider (sequence length -> estimated $/mo). Heavy attendees flagged for SDR outreach.
Teresa L: Chart headline drafts: A) "How sequence length drives latency (and cost)" B) "Workload comparison: where dollars stack up" C) "Optimization ladder: how batching, caching, quantization compound savings"
Matt G: Quick chart specs: A: bins 0-64,65-256,257-1024; primary y=ms/token; secondary y=$/1M tokens. B: grouped bars for chat/batch/embed, base vs quantized. C: waterfall showing incremental % savings annotated.
Elaine: Use colorblind-safe palette, label example prompt types (reply, short doc, long generation). Add brief note about token pricing assumptions.
Srini: Routing matrix: <120k -> marketing nurture; 120k-300k -> SDR outreach; >300k or enterprise domain -> AE handoff. Webinar engaged -> SDR. ops-bot to auto-tag with "perf-consider" and push CRM event.
ops-bot: (automated) Workflow created: bench-launch-flow. Will emit CRM events with tag and snapshot when criteria match.
Teresa L: Owners: Matt=charts+interactive mock, Elaine=UX+notes, Srini=AB+metrics, Josh=CTAs+CRM mapping. I'll synthesize slides and open PR. Any more asks?
Elaine: Add explicit baseline: ModelX-7B fp16, H100 profile.
Josh: I'll prepare the inbound filter list and SDR routing playbook.
Teresa L: Great, thanks team. Will post PR link once slides are in.
